independence.not_claimed: This is not an external human blind study, population sample, or independent scholarly adjudication.
independence.specification_awareness: The expected representation results deliberately apply the authored v1 specification, including its bounded ordinary-sukun pause rule. They do not independently validate the Arabic interpretation of that specification.
independence.exposure_protocol: Only paths, case counts, hashes, and schema/scope ambiguities are disclosed to the implementation author before implementation freeze. Individual cases and expected outputs are withheld until then.
independence.future_replay: After first exposure, this is an exposed regression benchmark; later improvements are not a fresh blind result.

authorship.examples: All benchmark texts are author-composed examples or deliberate perturbations, informed by the cited passages. They are not asserted to be verbatim quotations from the books.
authorship.representation_oracle: Each acquisition status and supplied cell list was hand-derived from the frozen specification. No production imports, recurrence copying, engine output, or normalization library were used to derive them.
manual_derivation_examples: O01: ha index25 fatha=100; dagger alif sukun=3; dhal index8 fatha=32; bare long alif sukun=3.
O07: mim damma=93; dal fatha=28; shadda ra sukun=39 then ra kasra=38; sin damma=45; tanwin nun sukun=99.
O08/O09: zay fatha=40; ya sukun=111; dal fatha=28; wasl tanwin adds nun99 and waqf adds alif3; written support alif emits no second cell.
P04/P07: qaf damma=81; mim sukun=95; ta damma=9 in wasl and ta sukun=11 at final-word waqf.
N04: subject dal fatha=28 then dual alif sukun=3 and possessive kaf fatha=84; predicate ba fatha=4 then alif3 and nun kasra98.

authorship.nominal_example_design: Positive nominal subjects use proper names, demonstratives, or possessive constructs, rather than relying on an unrestricted bare indefinite subject.

limits_and_interpretation: The source loci are digital extraction line numbers, not edition page numbers; OCR and source coverage remain limitations.
Positive acquisition goals with a correct DEFER representation status are coverage misses, not acquisition successes.

Category/person, nominal syntax, and conditional inference goals are separately desired downstream capabilities. Correct representation never discharges them; unavailable measurement must be UNMEASURED and expected-positive deferred goals must be misses.
Negative downstream goals are counterexamples to a specific undesired license. Conservative abstention on them cannot establish broad language understanding.

Source withdrawal/identity mutations, strict runtime type errors, resource bounds, transport limits, and native checker availability require a separate suite because the fixed gold row schema cannot represent those invocations or RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED.
Hidden-subject conditional cases intentionally require a separate reference-resolution license; scalar or shape equality cannot provide that license.
No gold representation result asserts acoustic truth, attestation, grammatical truth, speaker identity, world truth, or formalization of the Arabic books.
Only the named reasons explicitly fixed by the specification are frozen here; other deferred cases freeze the status rather than guessing an implementation-specific debt code.
Wasl here is the specification's local word-ending representation; the gold does not certify across-word phonetic assimilation.
scoring_requirements: Report representation agreement and false licenses separately from positive acquisition coverage.
Report downstream successes, misses, and unmeasured goals separately.
Preserve the first implementation run before any fixes.
